check.scope: Check marker-delimited artifacts, core exact shot timing/lenses, static crate, required script tokens, and obvious forbidden tokens. This is deliberately structural; acceptance still requires the standalone AST/API verifier and review call.

task:
Produce two human-inspectable artifacts for a 24 fps, 1920x1080 warehouse blocking scene targeting the Blender 5.2 Python API: (1) a JSON shot specification and (2) a Python `bpy` script that embeds that exact JSON as literal `SHOT_SPEC` and constructs it. Use exactly three cube placeholders: courier dimensions [0.8,0.6,1.8] at [-5,-4,0.9], crate [1.5,1.5,1.5] at [2,1,0.75], drone [1.2,1.2,0.4] at [0,2,7]. S01 frames 1-96: 28 mm wide establishing two-shot; courier moves to [-1,-1,0.9], crate fixed, drone excluded from visible subjects. S02 frames 97-168: 50 mm medium over-courier reveal; courier turns 45 degrees during 97-120; drone descends [0,2,7] to [0,2,4] during 121-168; crate fixed/visible. S03 frames 169-240: 35 mm low wide three-subject shot; courier retreats continuously to [-4,-3,0.9] and drone continuously descends to [0,2,2.5]; crate fixed. Each shot must state subjects, camera location/target/lens/framing, inclusive timing/duration, motions and constraints. The script must clear the scene, set frames/fps/resolution, create placeholders and one camera, aim it, and keyframe camera, lens and subject motion. Use exactly `look_at(obj,target)`, `key_transform(obj,data_path,frame,value)`, and `build_scene()` as the script functions. Imports are unaliased `import bpy`, `import math`, and `from mathutils import Vector`; no file/network/process access. If the owner names a Blender plugin before launch, reseal around that documented plugin interface instead of plain bpy; do not invent one.

Return the artifacts exactly between `BEGIN_SHOT_SPEC_JSON`/`END_SHOT_SPEC_JSON` and `BEGIN_BLENDER_SCRIPT`/`END_BLENDER_SCRIPT`, then a `BEGIN_CONTINUATION_LOG` block. The spec shape is `{schema_version,api_target,fps,resolution,scene,subjects[],shots[]}`; each subject has `{id,primitive,dimensions,initial_location,role}`; each shot has `{id,frame_start,frame_end,duration_seconds,subjects,camera:{location,target,lens_mm,framing},motion[],constraints[]}`; each motion has `{subject,data_path,frame_start,value_start,frame_end,value_end,description}`.

Treat acceptance as a conjunction: the host structural checker, the supplied standalone AST/API checker, and the scripted fallible review call. The structural checker is not an AST check. After every verify, record `{pass,decision,reason,failed_checks,planned_changes}` in the continuation log. Continue with another route/spawn/assemble/verify pass whenever a hard check fails, the reviewer leaves a high-severity issue, an artifact is missing, or another pass has a stated prospect of fixing the defect. There is no loop-count cap. The owner-required default USD 6 per-task spend ceiling is a host guard, overridable by the owner through `max_spend_usd` in the task file; remaining calls and estimated dollars are delivered to every continuation decision. Choose substantive STOP only by the stated rule. The host may also stop at the logical-call ceiling, spend ceiling, missing usable priced usage, or a concrete instrument failure; distinguish resource stops from instrument failures and do not call either exhaustion. Do not claim Blender was executed.

VISIBLE STATIC ACCEPTANCE CONTRACT. These are task inputs, not hidden checker choices. JSON must be finite, duplicate-free, and contain no fields beyond the declared exact shapes. Use schema_version "uc1.blender-blocking.v1", api_target "Blender 5.2 Python API", fps 24, resolution {"width":1920,"height":1080,"percentage":100}, and any nonempty scene string. Subjects are exactly three unique records with only id/primitive/dimensions/initial_location/role; use the stated courier/crate/drone values, primitive "cube", finite numeric vec3 values, and nonempty roles. Shots are exactly: S01_APPROACH, frames 1-96, duration 4.0, subjects ["courier","crate"], camera location [10,-14,8], target [0,0,1], lens 28, framing containing "wide", and its one stated courier-location motion; S02_REVEAL, frames 97-168, duration 3.0, all three subjects, camera [-4,-6,2.8], target [1.2,.5,1.2], lens 50, framing containing "over-courier", and exactly two motions—the courier rotation_euler [0,0,0] to [0,0,0.7853981633974483] at 97-120 and drone location motion stated above at 121-168; S03_RETREAT, frames 169-240, duration 3.0, all three subjects, camera [7,-10,2], target [0,0,1.5], lens 35, framing containing "low wide", and exactly the two stated courier/drone location motions. Each shot has only id/frame_start/frame_end/duration_seconds/subjects/camera/motion/constraints; camera has only location/target/lens_mm/framing; motion has only subject/data_path/frame_start/value_start/frame_end/value_end/description. Constraints/descriptions are nonempty. No crate motion or extra motion is allowed.

The AST grammar is intentionally narrow and may reject safe alternatives. Imports appear in exactly this order, without aliases or submodules: `import bpy`; `import math`; `from mathutils import Vector`. Functions are exactly `look_at(obj,target)`, `key_transform(obj,data_path,frame,value)`, and `build_scene()` with no defaults/varargs; the only module-level executable expression is final `build_scene()`. Required calls are exactly `bpy.ops.object.select_all`, `bpy.ops.object.delete`, `bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add`, `bpy.ops.object.camera_add`, object/camera-data `keyframe_insert`, `Vector`, `math.radians`, vector `to_track_quat`, quaternion `to_euler`, `tuple`, and the three local functions. Bind `bpy.context.scene` to a scene alias; bind mesh results from `bpy.context.object` to object aliases; store those objects in a `{}` dictionary; bind the camera result specifically to local name `camera` before using `camera.data`; use `Vector(target)-obj.location`, `to_track_quat("-Z","Y")`, and `to_euler()` for aim. Allowed receiver attributes are: Object—location, rotation_euler, name, scale, keyframe_insert; CameraObject—the same plus data; Scene—frame_start, frame_end, render, camera; RenderSettings—resolution_x, resolution_y, resolution_percentage, fps; CameraData—lens, keyframe_insert; Vector—to_track_quat; Quaternion—to_euler. Full `bpy` chains are limited to the required operators and `bpy.context.scene/object`; full `math` chains to `math.radians`. Do not use dynamic call targets, attribute calls directly on subscripts/call results, private/dunder access, aliases, globals/nonlocals, with/async/class/lambda/await/yield/try, reflection, or file/network/process APIs. Embed exactly the returned spec as literal SHOT_SPEC. Any continuation decision or RUN_CONTROL section within the generated artifact is a provisional self-check proposal made before host verification. The authoritative continuation decision must be made after actual verification through the pilot continue_or_stop control call, with that verification reference and a stated reason/stop rule. Let that control decide further passes as often as needed within the global 300-logical-call ceiling and owner-required spend guard; no task pass-count cap applies. Preserve and quote every actual control decision in the human reading.
